evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Mandating recurring rehearsals appeals to conservation (stability, keeping what works) while the aphoristic equivalence of unrehearsed-to-nonexistent appeals to competence (capability must be proven, not assumed).

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsAbsent
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression equate an unexercised capability with non-possession, making rehearsal the proof of having?
